identity.name: Greenfield Academy
identity.description: Day school in Port Harcourt offering Nigerian and British curricula from Nursery 1 to SS3.

offerings.name: Primary (Year 1-6)
offerings.description: Blended Nigerian and British curriculum, ages 5-11

offerings.name: Secondary (JSS1-SS3)
offerings.description: WAEC, NECO and IGCSE preparation, ages 11-17

faqs.question: Is there an entrance exam?
faqs.answer: Yes, for Primary 2 upwards. It covers English and Mathematics and is taken on the school tour day.

faqs.question: Do you provide school bus?
faqs.answer: Yes, on routes within Port Harcourt city. The cost depends on the route and is confirmed by the admissions office.

faqs.question: When does the next term start?
faqs.answer: The admissions office will confirm the next resumption date when you book a visit.
